bottlenecks.title: HCC1395-only 與 production authority 衝突

bottlenecks.title: 序列 I/O 與 full hashing
bottlenecks.detail: Preflight recomputes complete SHA-256 per locked file and scans indexed records; with a 292.06 GB BAM this can dominate before science starts.
bottlenecks.unblock: Measure per-stage I/O with C++ /proc/self/io and getrusage; never skip identity checks for speed.

bottlenecks.title: 舊輸出的小檔案爆量
bottlenecks.detail: The legacy HCC1395 extractor produced at least 239,061 site-level files across three artifact families.
bottlenecks.unblock: Use streamed BGZF native artifacts and indexes; do not recreate per-site directory trees.

bottlenecks.title: 記憶體與 transient storage 尚無物理上限證據
bottlenecks.detail: Current P2 accounting covers logical retained payload only; HTSlib buffers, allocator overhead, thread stacks and transient files are not bounded.
bottlenecks.unblock: Implement a process-wide permit budget, RSS sampler and transient-space/inode preflight.
